'''Dinner''' was the name given to one of the [[exoboar]]s in the litter of [[Sparky (exoboar)|Sparky]], a large exoboar kept by the [[Ravagers]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Rishi]] in the [[Galactic War]]. When the Ravagers' former leader [[Ruugar]] hired offworlders to storm the Ravagers' base in [[Coratanni Town]] in order to [[Death/Legends|kill]] his traitorous lieutenant [[Coratanni]], the offworlders slew Dinner and the other exoboars that guarded the town's gate along with their mother.<ref name="Ravagers" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dinner appears as one of over a dozen named exoboars that attack players during the fight with Sparky in "The Ravagers," an Operation added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''.
